# jsQR browser decoder

`jsQR-1.4.0.js` is the **unmodified** `dist/jsQR.js` from the npm package
`jsqr@1.4.0` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsqr/v/1.4.0).
Upstream: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR. License: Apache-2.0; the complete
upstream license is included as `jsQR-LICENSE.txt`.

SHA-256 of the shipped JavaScript:
`bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859`

Vendored deliberately so the door scanner needs no CDN, runtime package
resolution, or external script connection. No camera frames leave the browser.
To update: obtain an explicit upstream version, copy the distribution and
license, update this filename/reference/hash, and run the QR browser suite.
